text:
sara: Quick heads-up — onboarding 44b-ext into staging. weights are at s3://redwood-weights/44b-ext/v1/, tokenizer files live under `tokenizers/44b-ext`.

sara: Ran basic smoke generates, but seeing a tokenizer off-by-one: some prompts lose the leading <BOS> when using the HF tokenizer config we have.

mike: @sara can you paste the tokenizer example that fails?

sara: yeah, esp the prompt: "\nUser: Hello\nAssistant:" -> tokenized without a starting BOS id. Here's minimal repro:
```
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizers/44b-ext/tokenizer.json')
print(tok.encode('\nUser: Hello\nAssistant:').ids)
```
returns: `[501, 23, ...]` expected `[1, 501, 23, ...]` (1 is BOS for our radix)

jamal: hmm, looks like the `add_special_tokens` flag isn't set for the HF conversion. We had this with another 30b variant earlier.

eli: Also pinging about RoPE scalers — the model metadata has `rope_scale: 1.0` but the weights were trained with 1.05 for long-context. If we serve with 1.0 we get attention drift past 2048.

mike: can we validate by running the rope unit test in runtime? I can kick a quick job. Which config file should I use? `configs/44b-ext/serve.yaml`?

sara: yes that's the one. Key parts:
```
model:
  name: 44b-ext
  weights: s3://redwood-weights/44b-ext/v1/
  tokenizer_path: tokenizers/44b-ext/tokenizer.json
runtime:
  rope_scale: 1.05
  attention_impl: flash_attention
  gqa: true
  mqa: false
  sliding_window: true
```

gokul: flash_attention + GQA combo is fine, but make sure `attn_kernel_version` matches runtime (we have v2 in prod agents). If runtime falls back to naive attention it will blow latency.

deploy-bot: deploy request received for `staging/44b-ext` by sara. CI: started. Build id: ci-2026-03-15-2245

jamal: another thing — sliding window TTL for KV cache should be bigger for longer contexts. We had a bug where TTL=30s evicted mid-generation on bursty requests.

eli: agreed. set `kv_cache_ttl: 300` for the canary run. Also enable prefix-kv caching for repeated system prompts.

mike: running rope scaling test now. Will post logs if anything fails. ETA ~20m.

sara: thx. If tokenizer fix is trivial we can patch conversion script `tools/hf_to_redwood.py` to force `add_special_tokens=True` and reupload tokenizer artifact.

gokul: small caution — some HF tokenizers use `bos_token` vs `cls_token`. Make script robust: prefer `bos_token` then fallback to `cls_token` and set id mapping explicitly.

jamal: QA note: add a simple tokenization smoke to onboarding checklist: verify first token id == expected BOS id and run `rope_long_range` unit test.

mike: CI rope test passed locally (long-context attention diffs within tolerance) — logs:
```
INFO rope_test: max_rel_error=2.1e-3
INFO attn_impl: flash_attention v2
```

mike: pushing canary config now with rope_scale=1.05, kv_cache_ttl=300, attention_impl=flash_attention.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started. canary-id: canary-44b-ext-0007. healthchecks pending.

sara: can everyone add :eyes: on the canary health page if their dashboards look ok? I'll wait 30m and then promote to reserved if no regressions.

eli: will watch latency and OOM traces. If we see any memory spikes revert attention_impl to baseline and notify infra.

jamal: added tokenization test to the onboarding checklist PR (#4127). Please review quick.

mike: ack, reviewing PR now.

sara: thanks team — appreciate the quick sync. I'll follow up with a short postmortem if anything odd shows up.
